content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt plants, crushers and drilling rigs for road and quarry producers; shares road customers but builds different equipment."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and brake parts; building-envelope and vehicle components, not outdoor maintenance or farm machinery."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Architectural cladding, oilfield perforating guns and clad metal plates; no overlap with maintenance or agricultural equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemicals, polymers and fibers sold to manufacturers; a process chemicals business, not equipment manufacturing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pool and spa pumps, filters and heaters sold to residential and pool-builder channels; different products and customers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, fiberglass insulation and composite reinforcements; building materials rather than equipment for municipalities or farms."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Structural connectors, anchors and fasteners for building construction; building hardware rather than machinery."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Commercial mowers, turf equipment and attachments sold via dealers to landscapers, contractors and municipal grounds crews, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Recreational vehicles and buses sold through dealers to consumers and transit fleets; different products and end markets."}]}
